content: Human evaluation study: To verify that our results are in agreement with human judgment of how `characteristic' a tweet is, we ask human evaluators which of a pair of tweets sounds more characteristic of the given celebrity. The human evaluators are in agreement with our model 70.40% of the time, significant above the $0.05$ level for each of our 15 celebrities.
